objective: Decide whether deterministic single-paper QASPER exact-evidence extraction naturally supplies valid child-output credit targets and reward-informative groups cheaply enough to justify a separately frozen stock learning gate.

history.disposition: The learned judge remains rejected at balanced accuracy 0.75. The deterministic pivot changes the task claim and reward construct; it does not reinterpret the rejected gate as a pass.

claim.name: GA-QASPER-lite feasibility
claim.positive_scope: deterministic single-paper exact-evidence extraction with character-union F1

pinned_stack.model_resolution: Download the exact Hugging Face revision with the huggingface_hub version already frozen in Prime RL's uv.lock, serve the resolved immutable snapshot path, and record that path.

dataset.natural_smoke_selection: The first eight train rows in frozen source order, four rollouts each.
dataset.fixture_selection: The first train row, one forced integration rollout.
dataset.future_use: All eight natural-smoke paper IDs become smoke-only and are excluded from later training, validation, task inclusion, or threshold selection.

reward.parser: A literal Python list is required.
reward.validity: At least one predicted span and every predicted span must be nonempty and occur verbatim in the paper; otherwise precision, recall, and F1 are all zero.
reward.metric: Character-union precision, recall, and harmonic-mean F1 against exact QASPER evidence spans.

natural_smoke.purpose: Measure the behavior of the shared natural task interface without manufacturing decomposition.
natural_smoke.prompt_rule: Require the initial IPython action because the paper exists only in the runtime file; do not mention a minimum child count or require decomposition.
natural_smoke.episode_seed_rule: SHA-256 over canonical JSON {master_seed, example_id, replicate}; first 64 bits modulo 2^31-1 plus one.
natural_smoke.grouping: One environment serving session, eight actual Env task groups, four independent RunSlots per task, a distinct episode-addressed ModelContext seed per slot, and one shared frozen inference server.

forced_trace_fixture.purpose: Audit the already-reviewed RLM structural trace and paired cache/path plumbing without contributing to natural feasibility or scientific reward estimates.
mandatory_records: exact trace links and token routing
forced_trace_fixture.interpretation: Paired cache/path traversal and deterministic scorer-plumbing agreement only. The existing engine generates one terminal continuation and shares it across arms, so its reward equality is not independent real-task replay evidence.

natural_acceptance.eligible_pre_action_child_target: at least 26/32 traces have at least one structurally linked child policy call
natural_acceptance.informative_group_definition: Exactly four rollouts; all four parseable and all-verbatim; F1 range at least 0.05; at least two distinct rewards/advantages.
natural_acceptance.format_failure_variance: Reported separately and never counted as reward informativeness.
natural_acceptance.episode_seed_contract: 32 unique planned seeds and exact equality between each trace's first root-call seed and its persisted episode-addressed seed.

fixture_acceptance.paired_branches: at least two, one per child
fixture_acceptance.offline_scorer_fields_present: parsed spans, precision, recall, and F1 on every paired shared terminal

projection_inputs: natural rollout p50 and p95 service time
budget_projection.pass: The projected minimum stock design fits both the remaining original Stage D0 allocation after actual smoke billing and the wallet after preserving the $4 recovery reserve.
budget_projection.interpretation: Budget feasibility only; it does not freeze or power the stock learning gate.

decision.pass: Every natural, fixture, and budget check passes. This authorizes only CPU design and separate preregistration of a stock learning gate.
decision.fail: Stop before stock training and report the failed feasibility construct without threshold, seed, prompt, or task changes.
decision.stage_d1_blocker: Before any ReDCO real-task arm, build and audit an executor that independently restores task state, injects the child alternative, executes full and sliced schedules, reconstructs terminal outputs, and recomputes F1 in each arm.

repair_policy.principle: Outcome-independent infrastructure repair is allowed; observed scientific outputs are never silently discarded or resampled.
repair_policy.before_any_natural_completion: A demonstrated environment, transport, SSH, provisioning, or launcher defect may terminate the pod, be fixed under a versioned amendment, and be redeployed at most once.
repair_policy.after_any_natural_completion: Never rerun the natural 8x4 sample. Recover and report the terminal partial campaign.
repair_policy.fixture_only_failure_after_natural_compl: Preserve natural outputs. One bounded, versioned outcome-independent repair may rerun only the fixture if no fixture sampled alternative or terminal output was observed; otherwise do not rerun it.

resource_policy.hardware: exactly one non-spot 48GB A6000, A40, L40, L40S, or RTX 6000 Ada
resource_policy.hardware_amendment: Commit the exact resource ID, provider, location, GPU, and rate before provisioning.
resource_policy.ssh_rule: Verify noninteractively before syncing or model calls; terminate immediately on failure.
resource_policy.artifact_rule: Sync a compact compressed evidence bundle and hashes locally; do not retain model weights, Hugging Face/uv/CUDA caches, optimizer state, or redundant full traces outside the compressed evidence.
resource_policy.termination_rule: Terminate compute and confirm zero persistent disks after artifact recovery or any failure.
